## Key Professional Experience

### 1. Program Coordinator - Viswasanthi Development Foundation (June 2025 – June 2026)
- Coordinated the **Viswasanthi–TATA Elxsi Scholarship Programme**, providing financial aid, mentorship, and career guidance to economically disadvantaged Polytechnic students across Kerala.
- Coordinated large-scale soft skills and employability development programs in collaboration with **EY (Ernst & Young)**, impacting **over 25,000 students** with workplace readiness training.

### 2. Field Level Investigator - State Health System Resource Centre (SHSRC), Kerala & ICMR (January 2025 – April 2025)
- Conducted field investigations and systematic data collection for the ICMR-funded **SWAAS COPD Trial**.
- Contributed to community-based epidemiological research and public health assessment in Kerala.

### 3. Secretary - Karunyahastham Charitable Society, Thiruvananthapuram (October 2024 – December 2025)
- Led administrative operations, volunteer management, community outreach, and successful renewal of society registration.

## Research & Projects
- **Title**: Knowledge and Attitude towards Euthanasia
- **Category**: Quantitative Healthcare & Social Research
- **Summary**: Investigated awareness, ethical perspectives, and attitudes towards euthanasia among college students to understand youth perception on end-of-life decision-making.
